$comment: The plugin brings its own MCP server. The Meshy MCP server is the one this plugin is built against - it publishes 28 tools, and `references/tools.md` lists every one of them with its real cost.
$note: The server is started by scripts/install-meshy-mcp.ps1, which clones and builds it into mcp/meshy-mcp-server and writes the path into mcp/server.json. Until that script has run, the server will not start and the skills will say so rather than failing silently.
